title: 'Guaranteed 5% Daily Profit' - Myth or Scam?
caption: Educational only. Not financial advice. Regulators such as the SEC and the CFTC list guaranteed or unusually high returns with little risk as a classic fraud warning sign. Sources: investor.gov and cftc.gov alerts. AI-generated voice. Have you ever seen an offer that sounded too good to be true? Educational only. Not financial advice.

scenes.head: MYTH OR FACT
scenes.narration: Guaranteed daily profit in crypto. Myth or fact?

scenes.head: THE FACT
scenes.narration: All markets carry risk. Regulators like the S E C and the C F T C say promises of guaranteed returns are a classic warning sign.

scenes.head: THE TRICK
scenes.hook: EARLY PAYOUTS COME FROM NEW VICTIMS
scenes.narration: Many schemes pay small early gains to build trust, then push you to deposit more, and later block withdrawals.

scenes.head: THE FIX
scenes.hook: IF IT SOUNDS TOO GOOD, WALK AWAY
scenes.narration: Be wary of pressure, secret tips and promised profits. Check the company with your official regulator before sending anything.
